title: Events start workflows
summary: An event tells GitHub when to consider running a workflow. workflow_dispatch is manual; push reacts to selected pushed changes.
introduction: An event tells GitHub when to consider running a workflow. workflow_dispatch is manual; push reacts to selected pushed changes. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: An event tells GitHub when to consider running a workflow. workflow_dispatch is manual; push reacts to selected pushed changes.

blocks.text: A filter must match the real branch name to react to its pushes.
